subject.title: feat(agents): add iteration budget for agent loop safety

question: Should OpenClaw accept this opt-in iterationBudget config surface, onBeforeToolCallingRound core hook, supportsIterationBudget harness flag, and unsupported-harness fail-closed behavior as the post-release contract once the branch is rebased?
rationale: The patch is technically plausible and well-proven, but automation cannot decide the permanent public config/API/harness semantics for a new agent runtime safety surface.

options.title: Approve after rebase
